note: Optical dispersion library only. Every entry carries a citation and a validity range. RF permittivity, loss tangent and Pockels coefficients are intentionally NOT built in: they are device inputs that carry provenance in the sim config. Entries for which no verified coefficients are available are listed under `missing`.
verification: Coefficients compared against the refractiveindex.info database entries (CC0) cited in `source` for each item; n(1550 nm) cross-check is in engine/tests/materials.test.mjs.

formulas.sellmeier_c_squared: n^2 = 1 + sum_i B_i lambda^2 / (lambda^2 - C_i^2), lambda in um; array `C` stores C_i (not squared)
formulas.sellmeier_c: n^2 = 1 + sum_i B_i lambda^2 / (lambda^2 - C_i), lambda in um; array `C` stores C_i (as used)
formulas.table: tabulated n(lambda); evaluated by 3-point Lagrange interpolation

n.citation: I. H. Malitson, J. Opt. Soc. Am. 55, 1205-1208 (1965)
Salzberg and Villa, J. Opt. Soc. Am. 47, 244-246 (1957); fit form by Tatian, Appl. Opt. 23, 4477-4485 (1984)

silicon_nitride.description: Si3N4 (as deposited film, Luke et al.)

n.citation: K. Luke, Y. Okawachi, M. R. E. Lamont, A. L. Gaeta, M. Lipson, Opt. Lett. 40, 4823-4826 (2015)

lithium_niobate.description: congruent LiNbO3, room temperature; axes: a (ordinary, two axes), c (extraordinary)

n_o.citation: D. E. Zelmon, D. L. Small, D. Jundt, J. Opt. Soc. Am. B 14, 3319-3322 (1997), congruent LN, ordinary

n_e.citation: D. E. Zelmon, D. L. Small, D. Jundt, J. Opt. Soc. Am. B 14, 3319-3322 (1997), congruent LN, extraordinary

lithium_tantalate.description: LiTaO3, room temperature; tabulated data (no Sellmeier fit built in); dn/dlambda from 3-point interpolation of a 0.2 um grid, so group index carries an interpolation error

n_o.citation: W. L. Bond, J. Appl. Phys. 36, 1674-1677 (1965), ordinary ray

n_e.citation: W. L. Bond, J. Appl. Phys. 36, 1674-1677 (1965), extraordinary ray

missing.barium_titanate: Only Wemple-DiDomenico-Camlibel single-term fits (valid 0.4-0.7 um) found; not valid at 1550 nm; BTO thin-film indices depend on growth. Provide n in the sim config with provenance.
missing.lithium_tantalate_sellmeier: No verified Sellmeier fit in hand; tabulated Bond data used instead.
missing.rf_and_eo_coefficients: Not built in (device inputs with provenance in the config).
